effects.name: Grounded
effects.description: Insulated lining bleeds stray current into the floor.

effects.name: Steadied
effects.description: Hands stop shaking; sights stop drifting.

effects.name: Drawing In
effects.description: The Burden Projector is drawing your afflictions into its chamber. A stun breaks it off.

items.name: Lineman's Cowl
items.description: Rubberised hood from a maintenance crew that clearly expected trouble.

items.name: Arc Stitcher
items.description: Sews a seam of lightning between muzzle and target.

items.name: Burden Projector
items.description: A heavy rifle with a draw-line cuffed to the wrist. It pulls whatever ails the hand that holds it into the chamber and fires it at the next thing in the sights.

skill.name: Unburden
skill.description: The rifle spends a turn drawing every affliction on you into its chamber, then fires it into the target, with the turns and stacks each had left. What it takes, you are rid of.
skill.windupText: draws your afflictions into the chamber

items.name: Arcbite Rounds
items.description: Each round carries a [X]% chance to leave the target Shocked.

items.name: Steady Draught
items.description: Tastes of copper and good decisions.
